data.name: Alkesh
data.gender_notes: Alkesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Alkesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'alaksha' meaning 'without limits' and 'shasana' meaning 'ruler' or 'king'. This name signifies a person who rules over all senses and desires. In Hindu mythology, Alkesh is a name associated with Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunderbolts, and war. The name Alkesh carries the meaning “Ruler of all senses” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Alkesh usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of all senses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
